shopping.location_local: 北京市西城区杨梅竹斜街26号
shopping.notes_base: Independent cultural creative store tucked into Yangmeizhu Xiejie hutong. Highly recommended on XHS (2000+ likes) for hutong-themed gifts: Beijing postcards, illustrated fridge magnets, custom stamps, and small art prints with hutong motifs. Non-touristy — stock changes regularly. Open daily 09:30-19:30. Rating 4.7. No bargaining. WeChat Pay / Alipay accepted. Budget 50-150 CNY.
shopping.notes_local: 杨梅竹斜街上的独立文创小店，小红书高赞推荐（2000+赞）。主营胡同主题礼品：北京明信片、插画冰箱贴、手刻印章、胡同风格艺术画。非旅游纪念品性质，库存经常更换。每日09:30-19:30营业，评分4.7。不讲价，支持微信/支付宝。预算50-150元。

shopping.name_local: 祈润香舫(大栅栏西街商业店)
shopping.location_local: 北京市西城区杨梅竹斜街28号
shopping.notes_base: Small artisan incense studio at Yangmeizhu Xiejie 28, next door to Qiankun Space. Verified on XHS: the owner hand-makes incense sticks according to ancient Chinese formulas with no synthetic fragrances. XHS reviewers note no substitute exists for this incense. Products include: coil incense (盘香), stick incense (线香), and sachets (香囊). Packaged in traditional paper boxes — easy to carry home. Open daily 11:00-19:30. Rating 4.3. Budget 40-120 CNY per item.
shopping.notes_local: 位于杨梅竹斜街28号的手工香品工作室，紧邻乾坤空间。小红书验证：店主按古方手工制作线香，无任何合成香精。评价称没有平替。产品包括：盘香、线香、香囊。传统纸盒包装，便于携带。每日11:00-19:30营业，评分4.3。每件预算40-120元。

shopping.name_base: Ruifuxiang Silk Store (瑞蚨祥绸布店)
shopping.location_local: 北京市西城区大栅栏街5号
shopping.notes_base: Beijing's most famous 150-year-old silk and fabric shop, a Dashilar institution since 1893. Sells: traditional silk fabric by the meter, pre-made silk scarves (围巾), embroidered items, and Beijing silk souvenirs. NOT a tourist trap — this is a genuine historic brand (老字号) patronized by locals. Silk quality is authenticated. Good for: small silk items like handkerchiefs (手帕), sachets, or a single scarf. Open daily 09:30-20:30. Rating 4.6. Fixed prices (no bargaining). Budget 80-300 CNY for small items.
shopping.notes_local: 北京最著名的绸布老字号，1893年创立于大栅栏，历史超150年。出售传统丝绸布料（按米售）、成品丝巾、刺绣品及北京丝绸纪念品。非旅游陷阱，为正宗国家认定老字号，本地人常光顾，丝绸品质有保障。适合购买：手帕、香囊、丝巾等小件物品。每日09:30-20:30营业，评分4.6，明码实价不讲价。小件预算80-300元。

shopping.location_base: Xin Quan Street, Pingcheng District, Datong
shopping.notes_base: Datong's main antique and curio market. Good for browsing replica Northern Wei artifacts, old coins, calligraphy brushes and vintage items. Bargaining expected. Best visited in the morning before departing for Chengdu. Budget 50-150 CNY for small finds.
shopping.notes_local: 大同主要古玩市场。可浏览北魏风格仿古品、古钱币、毛笔和旧物。价格可讲价。建议赴成都前的上午前往。小件纪念品预算50-150元。

shopping.location_local: 成都市青羊区金河路口宽窄巷子
shopping.notes_base: Preserved Qing-dynasty alley complex. Shopping stops within: local tea shops (sell Mengding Mountain tea and jasmine), Sichuan opera face-change masks (变脸), ceramics, bamboo weaving, and lifestyle boutiques. Open 24 hours. Rating 4.8. Free entry. Best combined with People's Park tea house visit in the same area.
shopping.notes_local: 保存完好的清代巷子建筑群。内有茶叶店（蒙顶山茶、茉莉花茶）、变脸面具、陶瓷、竹编工艺品及生活类精品店。全天开放，评分4.8，免费入场。可与人民公园茶馆游览结合。

brands.name: Sichuan Tea Shops
brands.description: Sell Mengding Mountain Green Tea (蒙顶山绿茶), Bamboo Leaf Green (竹叶青), and jasmine tea. Packaged tins make excellent gifts. Expect to pay 50-200 CNY per tin.
brands.description_local: 出售蒙顶山绿茶、竹叶青茶、茉莉花茶。精装茶叶罐是优质礼品，每罐约50-200元。

brands.name: Face-Change Mask Souvenirs
brands.description: Decorative Sichuan opera face-change masks (变脸面具) in various sizes. Authentic artisan-made ones run 100-400 CNY. Decorative wall piece.
brands.description_local: 四川变脸面具装饰品，多种尺寸可选。手工制作品约100-400元，适合作墙面装饰。

shopping.location_local: 西安市碑林区书院门24号
shopping.notes_base: Xi'an's famous street for traditional arts near the Forest of Stone Steles Museum. Rubbings of Tang dynasty calligraphy (碑帖拓片), ink stones, brushes, antique seals, and Chinese painting reproductions. Open all hours, rated 4.7. Quieter and more authentic than Muslim Quarter for craft shopping. Budget 50-200 CNY for art supplies.
shopping.notes_local: 西安著名文化艺术街，紧邻碑林博物馆。出售唐代碑帖拓片、砚台、毛笔、古印章及中国画复制品。全天开放，评分4.7。比回民街更安静、更有文艺气息。书画文具预算50-200元。

brands.name: Rubbings of Tang Stone Steles
brands.description: Authentic and reproduction rubbings of famous Tang calligraphy inscriptions. Small sizes 30-100 CNY, large scrolls 200+ CNY. Rolls up for travel.
brands.description_local: 唐代著名碑刻拓片（真品及复制品）。小幅30-100元，大卷轴200元以上，可卷起便于携带。

brands.name: Chinese Calligraphy Supplies
brands.description: The Four Treasures of the Study: brush (毛笔), ink stick (墨), paper (宣纸), ink stone (砚). Sets from 80-500 CNY. Quality gift for art enthusiasts.
brands.description_local: 文房四宝：毛笔、墨、宣纸、砚台。套装价格80-500元，是艺术爱好者的精品礼物。

shopping.name_base: Nanjing Road Pedestrian Street — Option A, Light Browse (Closest, 3-min Walk)
shopping.location_base: Nanjing East Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai (3-min walk from hotel at Hankou Lu 678)
shopping.location_local: 上海市黄浦区南京东路步行街（距汉口路678号珍宝酒店步行约3分钟）
shopping.notes_base: Shanghai's iconic pedestrian street, steps from the hotel — ideal for a relaxed afternoon stroll between arrival (13:30) and the Bund evening walk. Best approach: skip the large department stores; head to the side lanes (石门一路 / Shimenshan Road arcade area) for independent shops. Avoid tourist souvenir stalls on the main strip. Practical buys: Wu Yutai tea (吴裕泰, 130-year old brand, packaged gift-ready tins), fresh pork moon cakes (鲜肉月饼) from non-chain bakeries on side streets, osmanthus cake (桂花糕). No bargaining, fixed prices. Open all day. Rednote-confirmed light-browse option for arrival afternoons.
shopping.notes_local: 上海地标步行街，距珍宝酒店步行3分钟，适合抵沪后13:30-17:00的轻度漫逛。建议绕开大型百货直奔侧巷小店，避免主街旅游纪念品摊。实用购物：吴裕泰茶叶（百年老字号、精装礼品）、非连锁小店鲜肉月饼和桂花糕。明码实价，无需讲价。小红书确认为到达日轻逛的推荐选项。

brands.name: Wu Yutai Tea Shop
brands.description: 130-year-old Beijing-origin tea brand with genuine packaged teas. One of the few legacy chains worth visiting — fixed quality, gift packaging. 50-200 CNY per tin.
brands.description_local: 百年老字号茶叶品牌，精装礼品茶质量稳定。每罐50-200元。

brands.name: Shanghai Specialty Snack Shops (Side Streets)
brands.description: Non-chain small bakeries selling osmanthus cake (桂花糕) and fresh pork moon cakes (鲜肉月饼). Budget 20-50 CNY. Avoid shops with tourist packaging.
brands.description_local: 非连锁小店出售桂花糕和鲜肉月饼，预算20-50元，避开旅游包装商品。

search_results.display_text: XHS - 上海南京东路步行街逛街

shopping.name_base: Wukang Road & Anfu Road — Option B, Old-Mansion Lane Boutique Stroll
shopping.location_base: Wukang Road & Anfu Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai (Metro Line 1 to Changshu Road, ~35 min from hotel)
shopping.location_local: 上海市徐汇区武康路、安福路（地铁1号线常熟路站，距酒店约35分钟）
shopping.type_local: 历史老洋房精品漫步街区
shopping.notes_base: Shanghai's most photogenic historic residential quarter: 1920s-1930s European-style villas (老洋房) line tree-canopied streets that have organically grown into a cluster of indie concept stores, bookshops, and galleries — without becoming a tourist trap. Walking the street itself is the experience; shopping is truly optional. Key stops: Duoyun Bookstore concept stores on Anfu Road (朵云书院, curated literary and art books), indie lifestyle stores in converted lane houses near Fuxing Road, small ceramic and jewelry studios. No closing time (open-air street). Best time 14:00-18:00 for plane-tree light. Rednote rates this as one of Shanghai's most authentic slow-browse 文艺 zones for locals and culturally curious visitors. Zero pressure to buy.
shopping.notes_local: 上海最具艺术气质的历史住宅街区，法国梧桐树荫下1920-30年代老洋房林立，自然形成独立概念店、书店和画廊聚落，非旅游人工打造。漫步街道本身即是体验，购物完全可选。重点：安福路朵云书院概念店（精选文艺图书和艺术类书籍）、复兴路附近里弄改建的独立生活馆、陶瓷和珠宝小工作坊。户外街道无固定关闭时间，最佳游览时间14:00-18:00（梧桐树光线最美）。小红书将此区评为上海最本真的文艺慢逛体验之一，无消费压力。

brands.name: Duoyun Bookstore — Anfu Road Concept Store
brands.name_local: 朵云书院安福路概念店
brands.description: Independent Shanghai literary bookshop with curated Chinese and bilingual titles, art books, and cultural gifts. Local cultural institution, not a chain. Budget 50-200 CNY.
brands.description_local: 上海独立文学书店，精选中英双语文学、艺术画册及文化礼品。本土文化机构，非连锁品牌。预算50-200元。

brands.name: Old Mansion Concept Lifestyle Shops
brands.description: Small concept stores in converted 1930s lane houses. Scented candles, hand-bound notebooks, local designer jewelry, linen home goods. Budget 80-400 CNY.
brands.description_local: 1930年代里弄老宅改建概念小店，出售香薰蜡烛、手工精装笔记本、本地设计师珠宝及亚麻家居用品。预算80-400元。

search_results.display_text: XHS - 上海武康路安福路逛街

shopping.location_base: 265 Fangbin Middle Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai
shopping.location_local: 上海市黄浦区方浜中路265号
shopping.notes_base: Large traditional market surrounding Yu Garden. Open 10:00-22:00. Rating 4.7. Sells: silk scarves and fans, lacquerware, jade carvings, tea sets, cheongsam (旗袍), and Shanghainese snacks. Popular area — visit on weekday morning if possible to avoid crowds. Adjacent to Old Town area already planned.
shopping.notes_local: 豫园周边大型传统集市。营业时间10:00-22:00，评分4.7。出售丝绸围巾、折扇、漆器、玉石雕刻、茶具、旗袍及上海特色小吃。人气旺盛，如可能建议工作日上午前往避开人流，紧邻已规划的老城厢景区。

brands.name: Silk & Qipao Boutiques
brands.description: Traditional Chinese qipao (旗袍) and silk scarves. Custom tailoring available at some shops (2-3 day turnaround). Scarves from 80-300 CNY, qipao from 300-1500 CNY.
brands.description_local: 传统旗袍和丝绸围巾。部分店铺提供定制服务（需2-3天）。围巾80-300元，旗袍300-1500元。

brands.name: Lacquerware & Jade Craft Stalls
brands.description: Carved lacquerware boxes, jade pendants and bangles. Beware of synthetic 'jade' — real nephrite and jadeite are cold to touch and much heavier. Budget items 50-200 CNY.
brands.description_local: 漆雕工艺品盒、玉石吊坠和手镯。注意辨别真假玉石——真玉触感冰凉、质地较重。普通工艺品预算50-200元。

brands.name: Shanghai Traditional Tea Sets
brands.description: Yixing clay teapots (宜兴紫砂壶) and gongfu tea sets. Small travel-size sets from 100 CNY. Genuine Yixing ware has hallmarks and maker's seal.
brands.description_local: 宜兴紫砂壶和功夫茶具。旅行小套装从100元起。正宗宜兴紫砂有品牌印章。

shopping.name_base: Xintiandi (新天地) — Option A, 石库门 Heritage Lifestyle District
shopping.location_base: 181 Taicang Road, Huangpu District, Shanghai (Madang Road / Huangpi South Road Metro, ~15 min from hotel)
shopping.location_local: 上海市黄浦区太仓路181弄（马当路/黄陂南路地铁站，距酒店约15分钟）
shopping.type_base: 石库门 Heritage Lifestyle & Boutique District
shopping.type_local: 石库门里弄精品生活街区
shopping.notes_base: Xintiandi (新天地) is a 石库门 (shikumen) heritage neighborhood from the 1920s-1930s, sensitively converted into Shanghai's most refined upscale lifestyle district. Two blocks: North Block (北里) has independent boutiques, galleries, and concept stores in restored stone-gate lane houses; South Block (南里) has restaurants and terrace cafes. NOT a chain mall — the entire district is built around historical architecture. Best finds: independent fashion boutiques, design lifestyle stores (ceramics, glassware, linen goods), Shanghai-themed art prints, artisan chocolate and coffee. Open 10:00-22:00 (most shops). Free entry. Rating 4.8. Strong 文艺温馨 vibe that aligns with Jade INFJ aesthetic. Rednote frequently features this area as authentic and non-touristy for locals. Budget 150-300 CNY for browsing / coffee / light purchases.
shopping.notes_local: 新天地保留了1920-30年代石库门里弄建筑群，经精心改造为上海最精致的高端生活街区。北里为独立精品店、画廊、概念店（石库门老宅内）；南里为餐厅和露台咖啡。非连锁商场，整个街区以历史建筑为依托。推荐购物：独立时尚精品店、设计生活馆（陶瓷、玻璃器皿、亚麻用品）、上海主题艺术版画、手工巧克力和精品咖啡。营业时间10:00-22:00，免费入场，评分4.8。文艺温馨氛围非常契合INFJ审美偏好。小红书多次将此地评为本地人心中最真实、非旅游化的高质量商业街区。预算150-300元（逛街/咖啡/轻度购物）。

brands.name: North Block Independent Boutiques
brands.description: Small indie stores in restored shikumen houses: ceramics, linen homewares, art prints, Shanghai-designed jewelry. Non-chain. Budget 80-400 CNY.
brands.description_local: 石库门老宅内的独立小店：陶瓷、亚麻家居、艺术版画、上海本地设计饰品。非连锁，预算80-400元。

brands.name: Xintiandi Style — Design Concept Store
brands.description: Curated lifestyle and design store unique to Xintiandi. Shanghai-designed stationery, gifts, art objects. Good for distinctive souvenirs with design value. Budget 50-300 CNY.
brands.description_local: 新天地专属的精选设计生活馆，上海本地设计文具、礼品和艺术摆件，具有设计价值的独特纪念品。预算50-300元。

brands.name: South Block Terrace Cafes
brands.description: Outdoor terrace seating in restored lane houses. Good for a mid-afternoon coffee break while exploring. Budget 40-80 CNY per drink.
brands.description_local: 老宅改建的露台咖啡座，适合逛街中途休息。下午茶预算40-80元/杯。

search_results.display_text: XHS - 上海新天地石库门逛街

shopping.name_base: Huaihai Middle Road & K11 Art Mall — Option B, Upscale Boulevard Browsing
shopping.location_base: Huaihai Middle Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai (Metro Line 1 to Shanxi South Road or Changshu Road, ~25 min from hotel)
shopping.location_local: 上海市徐汇区淮海中路（地铁1号线陕西南路或常熟路站，距酒店约25分钟）
shopping.notes_base: Shanghai's most elegant historic shopping boulevard — the French Concession's main artery. Less touristy than Nanjing Road, more local and upscale. Key stretches between Shanxi South Road and Changshu Road have a mix of international boutiques, Chinese skincare brands (Proya 珀莱雅, Florasis 花西子), and high-end tea shops. K11 Art Mall integrates contemporary art installations with retail — unique in China. Street-level browsing is free; perfect for window shopping with occasional purchases. Adjacent to Wukang Road — can combine both on the same afternoon. Open all day. Authentic local shopping zone.
shopping.notes_local: 上海最优雅的历史购物大道，前法租界主干道。比南京路更本地化、更高端。陕西南路至常熟路段汇集国际精品店、国产美妆品牌（珀莱雅、花西子）及高端茶叶专卖店。K11购物艺术中心融合当代艺术装置，是中国唯一此类体验。街头漫步免费，可与武康路合并下午一并游览。全天开放。

brands.name: K11 Art Mall
brands.description: Art-integrated shopping mall with rotating contemporary art installations. Unique in China for blending art with retail. Worth a look even without buying. 10:00-22:00.
brands.description_local: 融合当代艺术装置的购物艺术中心，中国首创的艺术购物体验，即使不购物也值得一逛。营业时间10:00-22:00。

brands.name: Chinese Skincare & Beauty Brands
brands.description: Huaihai Road has flagship stores for premium Chinese skincare brands: Proya (珀莱雅), Florasis (花西子), Winona (薇诺娜). Quality gifts at 50-300 CNY. Fixed prices.
brands.description_local: 淮海路汇集国产高端护肤品旗舰店：珀莱雅、花西子、薇诺娜等。礼品价值高，50-300元，明码实价。

search_results.display_text: XHS - 上海淮海中路逛街推荐

shopping.location_local: 北京市东城区王府井大街256号
shopping.notes_base: Beijing's most famous shopping street, open 24 hours, rated 4.8. Final opportunity for gifts and souvenirs before departure. Mix of large department stores (Wangfujing Department Store, Oriental Plaza nearby), foreign brand outlets, and specialty shops. Foreign Language Bookstore (外文书店) on this street is excellent for bilingual books and gifts. Good for last-minute Chinese tea, silk items, and high-quality packaged snacks.
shopping.notes_local: 北京最著名购物街，全天开放，评分4.8。离京前最后购物机会。有王府井百货、东方广场等大型商场，也有外资品牌门店和特色小店。王府井外文书店是购买双语书籍和文化礼品的好地方。最后可购买中国茶叶、丝绸商品及精装特产零食。

brands.name: Foreign Language Bookstore
brands.description: Multi-floor bookstore with English and European language books, bilingual children's books, and China-themed gifts. A must-visit for book lovers.
brands.description_local: 多层书店，有英文及欧洲语言书籍、双语儿童书和中国主题礼品，书迷必访。

brands.name: Wangfujing Snack Street
brands.description: Famous snack alley branching off Wangfujing. Packaged snacks and preserved foods make good last-day purchases. Note: exotic 'scorpion skewers' are a tourist gimmick — locals don't eat them.
brands.description_local: 王府井旁著名小吃街。袋装零食和特产食品是最后一天购物的好选择。注意：蝎子串是旅游噱头，本地人并不食用。
